items.title: Why Is Deere (DE) Rehiring Workers Before Labor Contract Talks?
items.summary: Deere (NYSE:DE) has recalled more than 275 previously laid-off employees and plans to hire over 400 new workers ahead of contract talks. The workforce changes come as Deere prepares for upcoming negotiations with the United Auto Workers union that represents many factory employees. The rehiring follows earlier job cuts at Deere facilities, signaling a shift in staffing plans before formal labor discussions begin.
